summary: Neo’s program is now Neo Residency, advertising Winter 2027. Startups receive $750K uncapped funding with participation rights up to 5% in the next equity round; the three-month SF program includes a two-week Texas bootcamp. No exact deadline is published.

proposed_event.name: Neo Residency — Winter 2027
proposed_event.description: Three-month San Francisco residency for startups and student teams. Startup terms: $750K uncapped funding plus next-round participation rights up to 5%.

dates.date_range_text: Winter 2027; three months in San Francisco with a two-week Texas bootcamp. Exact application cutoff and program dates are not published.

sources.title: Neo Residency Winter 2027
sources.supports: Official indexed residency page confirms rebrand, Winter 2027, funding, SF program and Texas bootcamp.

notes: Older portal page describes an Oregon bootcamp and yearless summer dates; prefer the current Winter 2027 residency page.
